facts.claim: Viking Mars (Viking): Entered service 2022; 47,800 GT; 930 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 227 m length; Star class.
The Viking program consisted of a pair of identical American space probes, Viking 1 and Viking 2 both launched in 1975, and landed on Mars in 1976.
Each spacecraft was composed of two main parts: an orbiter spacecraft which photographed the surface of Mars from orbit, and a lander which studied the planet from the surface.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Viking; entered service 2022; 47,800 GT; approx. 930 guests.
